We strive for excellence - in everything we do

We are the global go-to partner for pharmaceutical primary packaging, drug delivery systems and solutions, offering the broadest range of products for the pharma, biotech, health and cosmetics industries. We ensure the safe delivery and reliable administration of all kinds of drugs to the patient. Customers and partners from all over the world trust us to solve new challenges. We are their solution provider, committed to delivering from concept to final product, and to global manufacturing at scale. This is how we meet the requirements of our customers and their end customers.

Unique and broad range of products

Our unique and broad range of products, systems and solutions is available around the globe, close to our customers and patients. With around 13,000 employees and 39 production plants worldwide, we produce in the region for the region.

Our extensive product portfolio includes pharmaceutical primary packaging and systems and solutions for the safe and convenient administration of drugs: insulin pens, inhalers, on-body devices, prefillable syringes, vials, ampoules, bottles and containers for liquid and solid medicines with closure and safety systems, as well as packaging for the cosmetics and food & beverage industry.

Involving – together with our customers

Our customers are involved in the solution-finding process, and we leverage the expertise of our joint global teams. Thanks to this collaboration and our passion for excellence, we succeed together.

Focussing on pharma, biotech and healthcare

  • 81 % of our revenues are generated from the pharma industry
  • 12 % of our revenues are coming from the cosmetic industry
  • 7% of our revenues are stemming from the food & beverage and nutritional supplements industries
